narrative.overview: Original Sunburst cinema architecture, oversized editorial typography, electric coral and chartreuse make Ludex a personal premiere. Real catalog covers remain interactive. Rounded story frames give the feed depth; curated showcase shelves turn taste into the center of attention. Web and Android share the visual world while retaining their platform navigation.
keyCharacteristics: Bold editorial titles with tactile poster interactions
Fast actions with finite, preference-aware motion

rules.name: Premiere palette
rules.body: Coral anchors actions; chartreuse marks progress and logging. Pale orchid supplies readable contrast.

rules.name: Immediate action
rules.body: Controls work throughout animation. Never delay logging, navigation or input focus.

dos: Honor saved and system reduced motion.
Use real catalog covers for media identity.
donts: Do not animate continuously or hijack scrolling.
Do not claim physical performance from screenshots.
Do not make uncertain integrations appear connected.
